name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response aligns with the provided context and interesting fact.

name: Coherence
description: Assesses the logical flow and consistency of the response.

name: Creativity
description: Evaluates the originality and imaginative quality of the response.

name: Engagement
description: Measures how interesting and captivating the response is to the reader or listener.

name: Factual Accuracy
description: Assesses the accuracy of any facts or details included in the response.
